image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab on a white plate. The crab is bright orange-red, indicating it has been boiled or steamed. The carapace is broad and oval. Two large claws are visible at the front, along with several walking legs tucked underneath or extending to the sides. A second crab is partially visible in the foreground, out of focus. The background features horizontal blue blinds.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The claws are robust, but they do NOT have dark tips. Cooked Dungeness crab claws typically have white/cream tips with orange joints. The 'dark tip' feature applies to live/raw crabs. Additionally, the claws appear roughly symmetrical, not clearly unequal in this view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Claws have smooth outer surface and serrated inner edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The outer shell of the claws appears smooth. The inner edges are difficult to see in detail but the general morphology fits.

The legs on the left side appear to merge slightly with the plate edge and each other, lacking distinct separation at the joints. This suggests minor structural ambiguity common in AI generation.
The elliptical curve of the plate rim seems slightly inconsistent with the perspective of the table/background blinds, though subtle.
